fieldNotes.truckGate: Open-access site. Kettle Court SE ends in a wide open paved cul-de-sac/apron directly in front of the plant's dock face. 2025-06 Street View shows no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint - and no perimeter fence on the truck side. A Campbell's sign confirms the facility identity.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the entrance - only the plant building and a Campbell's identity sign.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Kettle Court SE is a short dead-end street; the approach from the road to the dock area is shallow (1-2 truck depth).
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single open approach via Kettle Court SE serves both inbound and outbound.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock bank on the building's east face with ~4-7 trailers backed in under dock canopies; estimated ~10-15 doors - band 10-25. Counted from zoom-20 imagery, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Few trailers parked without tractors near the dock apron; 0-10 band - no dedicated drop yard.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot; trailer parking is limited to the dock-apron area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Salem OR (state capital, mid-size metro) - the plant sits in an established SE-Salem industrial park surrounded by other industrial buildings; classified Urban. Mill Creek and a wetland border the west/south.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~16 acres from perimeter box (~290m N-S x ~285m E-W of the developed parcel).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur serves the property.
fieldNotes.solar: Large rooftop solar array (one of the larger PNW installations, installed 2001) - confirms identity but not operationally relevant to the yard classification.
fieldNotes.confidence: High - facility positively confirmed by Campbell's signage in Street View; open no-gate/no-guard determination is clear. Dock and trailer counts are honest overhead estimates (flagged).
